response.sql:
WITH college_player_counts AS (
    SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_player_counts
)
SELECT cpc.state,
       AVG(cpc.player_count) AS avg_college_player_count,
       AVG(cpc.player_count / o.avg_count) AS avg_count_relative_to_overall,
       AVG(cpc.player_count / o.total_count) AS avg_college_share_of_total
FROM college_player_counts AS cpc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
GROUP BY cpc.state;

assumptions.assumption: A college's count is the number of distinct players linked to it; repeated player_college rows for the same player and college count once. Colleges with no player_college row are excluded because the request starts with colleges represented in player_college.
